failure_signature.detail: Project setup invoked git rev-parse while pip prepared editable-build requirements; Git rejected /data/project as dubious ownership before the generated type stubs were created or Pyright ran.

statistical_disposition.reason: The frozen A candidate boundary rejected this exact program before Official submission, so A remains a pre-Official algorithm failure. The diagnostic cannot establish whether accepting the generated type stubs would have produced a benchmark pass because an earlier Official checkout-ownership mismatch deterministically stopped installation.

causal_interpretation.algorithm_implication: First make in-session replay reproduce Official checkout ownership. Only then can post-execution provenance and effect checks evaluate generated type-stub repairs without this upstream confound.

deployment_completeness.reason: The program installed substantial real dependencies but supplied .pyi-only distributions for HyRoDyn and an unavailable internal Phobos module; executable behavior was not established.
